page.overview:
Who is Hazei?

At the grand party in 66 BG held to celebrate Roku being declared the new Avatar, Hazei was seated at the head table next to her husband. The following morning, she bowed to Roku as he prepared to depart to the Southern Air Temple, and the new Avatar returned the gesture.

Hazei was one of the few people other than the Royal Fire Healer to truly know about the extent of her husband's senility. In 63 BG, she and her husband held a private family meeting with Sozin and Zeisan to discuss the matter. She informed her children that Taiso's cognitive decline would only be worsening over the coming years. She later interjected to try and stop Sozin and Zeisan from arguing about their father's illness and their old grudges.

Hazei was calm and unassertive compared to her husband and children, and grew deeply sad when discussing Taiso's dementia. She was deferential to her husband, agreeing when he told her to treat the Royal Fire Healer's diagnosis as only a "claim" rather than fact.
